root_cause: Production browser readback jobs remained in the same Playwright step beyond the verifier's intended internal budget. Internal JavaScript budgets cannot terminate a wedged browser/protocol/process operation; the enclosing job-level 25 minute timeout was still the only guaranteed process circuit breaker.
prevention_rule: Every production browser verifier must be wrapped in a process-level timeout materially below the job timeout, in addition to internal navigation/page budgets.

invariants: pricing production browser step has an OS-level timeout
public-page visibility browser step has an OS-level timeout
process timeout is shorter than the 25-minute job cap
timeout is fail-closed and does not weaken browser assertions
